nodes.label: twine CLI
nodes.desc: dispatch() loads subcommands from the twine.registered_commands entry-point group

nodes.label: twine upload
nodes.desc: upload() orchestrates signing, attestations, and posting each dist

nodes.label: twine check
nodes.desc: validates that long_description renders on PyPI via readme_renderer

nodes.label: dist discovery
nodes.desc: _find_dists globs patterns and sorts wheels first; _split_inputs separates .asc and .attestation files

nodes.label: Settings
nodes.desc: merges argparse options, .pypirc sections, and env vars; chooses interactive vs private credential resolver

nodes.label: Credential Resolver
nodes.desc: Resolver pulls username/password from CLI, keyring, or trusted-publishing OIDC minting

nodes.label: .pypirc & helpers
nodes.desc: get_config reads ~/.pypirc with UTF-8 fallback; sanitize_url masks userinfo; check_status_code maps 410/405 to hints

nodes.label: PackageFile
nodes.desc: opens a dist, validates METADATA/PKG-INFO, hashes it, and builds the upload form dictionary

nodes.label: SDist
nodes.desc: factory that picks TarGzSDist or ZipSDist and extracts PKG-INFO

nodes.label: Wheel
nodes.desc: reads *.dist-info/METADATA from a .whl and parses pyver from the filename

nodes.label: Repository
nodes.desc: posts multipart :action=file_upload forms with retries and answers package_is_uploaded from the JSON API

nodes.label: Exceptions
nodes.desc: Typed failure taxonomy: InvalidDistribution, RedirectDetected, TrustedPublishingFailure, and friends
